results.title: Forevergreen
results.overview: An orphaned bear cub finds a home with a fatherly evergreen tree, until his hunger for trash leads him to danger.

results.title: Big Little Man
results.overview: Emile, 7, has decided to leave childhood behind. From one day to the next, he has become an adult, a big boy who is no longer totally in tune with the world around him.

results.title: Made in Eddington
results.overview: Made in Eddington gives a behind the scenes look at the making of Ari Aster's modern political nightmare.

results.title: Todo El Vino
results.overview: A couple discusses their life changing goals after dinner

results.title: Christine
results.overview: Christine is an intimate, dialogue-driven short about connection in the modern world. Over the course of a late-night video call, Nick and Christine drift from playful debate into deeper, more vulnerable territory, revealing their fears, contradictions, and unspoken desires for intimacy. As their conversation unfolds in fragments and jump cuts, the film explores how easily two people can feel close through conversation alone, and how fragile that closeness can be once the call ends

results.title: Great White Waters
results.overview: When millions in cartel cocaine go missing off Florida's coast, the search turns savage as vicious sharks close in on anyone daring to claim the stash.

results.title: The Perfect Gamble
results.overview: Two gamblers released from prison decide to open an illegal casino, but get entangled with the mafia, with one gambler's girlfriend caught in the middle.

results.title: McWomen
results.overview: The profits at McDonald's aren't very good, so to fix that, Ronald McDonald is launching the McWomen menu, a menu reserved for women..

results.title: The Criollos
results.overview: What is your home, the one you build day by day or the one you left behind? Argentina welcomed more than 300,000 Venezuelans, among them Julio Briceño, founder of Criollos, an amateur baseball team that has become a symbol of migration. About to turn 10, they lose their public stadium: once again homeless. Julio begins the search for a field of his own with his community.

results.title: OnlyFangs
results.overview: A wannabe monster hunter helps a bloodthirsty gang of vampire chicks expand their business by creating a new app to turn their victims into customers.

results.title: Homeseek
results.overview: The difficulties faced by a Brazilian emigrant in finding an affordable flat in Lisbon.

results.title: Shapeless
results.overview: A film about what it means to grow up as a young South Asian girl in Japan — navigating family, love, and yearning.

results.title: That Summer I Got Accepted to University
results.overview: In a Russian country house, two boys, Anton and Zhenya, shoot air rifles at bottles. Anton suddenly fires at a cat, shocking Zhenya. Their friendship becomes strained. That evening, Anton's father takes them to the river and recalls his own childhood, when he built a forest shelter together with a friend. As night falls, Anton tries to reconcile, but Zhenya rejects his friendship. The next day, at the bus stop, they part without speaking, their silence filled with unspoken tension and guilt.

results.title: Sarbala Ji
results.overview: Sucha’s harmless wedding prank turns into a wild curse, leading to runaway grooms, bandits, secret crushes, and a bride who loves farms over fashion.

results.title: Jagala
results.overview: Jagala is a story of a young Muslim man named Chekku who lived in Eranad during the Mappila Rebellion era of 1920s.

results.title: Anna Asti. The Queen
results.overview: A documentary about the creation of Anna Asti's stadium concert.

results.title: Ship
results.overview: Ship is an overnight cruise on the occasion of a birthday celebration of Algirdas Stravinskas, the star of Lithuanian choreography in the former Soviet Union, culminating in a dance performance by a young contemporary dance troupe. On the cruise, the universal urge for beauty and creativity unites those who have already become history and those who are yet to make it.
